registered: 2026-11-18, before producing any new event classifications, evaluated alternative values, or rank results. Prior work measured 43,260 non-extensions on folds 3/4. This is a new internal validation with historical fold reuse, not an external test.
question: When the hypothetical straight escape has no capturing ladder on the full board, what does a player do instead, what can be observed two enemy turns later, and does the choice reveal adjacent grade beyond the existing SQ4 posterior?
mechanisms: Adapt discrete choice by conditioning on availability of the straight escape. Measure relative action value by scoring two children of the identical pre-action position. Use a separate delayed-outcome measurement inspired by action valuation in team sports. The value of an unplayed action is the engine's estimate. The recorded opponent reactions on the actual branch are observational.
events: All alternate responses to verified favorable extensions under the exact earlier defense definition, with original handicap, color, atari and consecutive-chase suppression. Require exact counts per game and local verdict/chain-size cell against the earlier artifact. Store original coordinates, move number, initial size and local verdict. Disjoint action classes in priority order: original chain immediately regains >=2 liberties; captures enemy stones; newly puts another enemy string in atari; another move within Chebyshev 3 of the escape; farther move; pass. Record overlapping immediate flags separately.
horizon: Replay the played alternative, the next opponent move, own next move, then the second opponent move. Keep the original chain identity through connections; once the original stones have been taken, they stay marked lost even on reoccupation. Report immediate, first-reply and two-reply endpoints, captures by the subject in the window, and the observed gain of at least as many opponent stones as the starting size when lost. Treat records ending before the second reply as incomplete for horizon estimates. Never supply future observed moves to the action-value judge.
judge: All eligible alternatives in folds 1–4: strong self-play KataGo kata1-b18c384nbt-s9996604416-d4316597426, v1.18.2, fixed input symmetry, Japanese rules and original M25 komi handling. Replay identical history to the decision; append actual or escape as its final move. Delta is raw lead for the mover on actual child minus escape child. With SIDETOMOVE this equals opponent-view escape lead minus actual lead. Audit an approximately 1/32 fixed hash sample using 16 visits per child and identical-branch duplicate checks. Report median delta, shares outside +/-1 point and agreement with searched values. An estimate near zero is uncertain.
models: Fit only on player-disjoint folds 1/2; lock both fits and compare on historical folds 3/4. Generic frequency control = prior four-cell exposure/favorable/extension frequencies plus alternative counts. Choice model adds six action shares smoothed per question. Value model adds per-question mean clipped delta/10 (clip +/-10), shares above +1 and below -1, and corresponding mean delta for instant rescue, capture/atari, and other actions. Shrink mean/signal features toward zero with four pseudo-events. Outcome model further adds recorded horizon completion, original-chain loss, loss without equal material compensation, and stones captured (clip at 5) per completed alternative. Always report the control, each stage, and a negative control that permutes delta on unique events within fold, action, phase (<80,80–159,160+), chain size (1/2+) and local verdict, preserving duplicate-question consistency.
head: Calibrate just the log odds 1D/2D and 3D/4D from the fixed SQ4 posterior; conserve total pair mass and every other class probability. Fit separate logistic residuals on the true grades of each respective pair, with balanced size and grade weights, features residualized on development against intercept, base conditional log odds, its square and log game count, standardized, clipped to +/-4. L2 penalty 0.05 times sum beta squared on mean NLL. Without features reproduce original SQ4 decisions using its original ct106 guard. No feature selection by validation results.
decision: Primary rank claim requires value minus choice and value minus SQ4 both to have positive lower endpoints in paired two-sided 95% intervals resampling players within true grade, pooled value-minus-SQ4 >=0.001 and positive in each evaluation fold. Action-only and observed results are diagnostic, not substitutes. Report official equal-grade and size score, adjacent-pair held-out conditional NLL/AUC, improved/worsened, and model score differences; abstain from retuning on test folds. For measuring stability use one 20-game question per eligible player in folds 3/4, fixed disjoint 10/10 random halves over 20 seeds. No official questions, fold 0, identity or leaderboard.
